title: New Government Subsidy for Rice Farmers
overview: The Department of Agriculture has announced a new subsidy program aimed at helping rice farmers affected by recent weather disturbances.
highlights: Up to 50% subsidy on certified seeds

title: El Niño Preparation Guidelines Released
overview: PAGASA has released comprehensive guidelines for farmers to prepare for the upcoming El Niño phenomenon expected to hit the country late this year.
highlights: Early planting advised for wet season crops

title: Fall Armyworm Outbreak in Northern Luzon Contained
overview: The recent outbreak of Fall Armyworm affecting corn fields in Northern Luzon has been successfully contained through rapid intervention.
highlights: Free bio-control agents distributed to affected areas
